title: TWITTER X7 current product and build selector
notes: The live page displays 7.6 kg and its detailed specification says net weight from 7.6 kg. The page selector displays SENTYEH ES7000 1x14 wireless, matte black and XS (46 cm) by default, while the product lists five build choices. It does not say that the 7.6 kg value is measured for that selected combination or give the weighing method; the retained mainland price observations are not mapped to a selected build.
